1	# JS/TS — detection
2	
3	Declares when the `js_ts` profile activates on a given set of files. Consumed by `klaude-plugin/skills/_shared/profile-detection.md`. Multiple profiles may activate additively on the same diff.
4	
5	The profile covers JavaScript and TypeScript jointly: review concerns (typing, async, modules, React patterns) overlap substantially, and the ecosystem tools (npm, bundlers, Node/browser runtimes) are shared.
6	
7	## Path signals
8	
9	_None._ JS/TS detection does not use path heuristics; file extension alone is authoritative (see Content signals).
10	
11	## Filename signals
12	
13	_None._ JS/TS detection is extension-based, not filename-based.
14	
15	## Content signals
16	
17	A file activates the JS/TS profile if its extension is one of: `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.mts`, `.cts`. The extension match is authoritative; no byte-level content inspection is required.
